title: Crispy Iberico Pork Belly Bites
description: A Spanish-inspired appetizer featuring crispy Iberico pork belly, served with a side of tangy umami sauce.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, toss the pork belly pieces with olive oil, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper until evenly coated.
3. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the pork belly pieces in a single layer.
4. Bake for 20 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
5. While the pork is baking, heat 2-3 tablespoons of olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
6. Add the jamon ibérico slices to the saucepan and fry until crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
7. Remove the pork from the oven and let it cool slightly.
8. Serve the crispy pork belly bites with a side of umami sauce and garnish with chopped parsley and crispy jamon ibérico slices.
